definitions.explanation: Music performed in person by musicians at the venue, as opposed to recorded or synthesized music. Valued for its immediacy and authenticity.

examples.japanese: {生演奏|なまえんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦ジャズ→ジャズ：07084_jazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生演奏|なまえんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has live jazz every evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生演奏|なまえんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれて→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: A friend played live piano at the wedding, and it was very moving.

notes:
USAGE:
The prefix ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (live, raw) distinguishes this from recorded music. {生演奏|なまえんそう} can refer to any genre — classical, jazz, rock, etc. Common at restaurants, hotels, wedding receptions, and concert venues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧ (to listen to a live performance)
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}つき (with live music)
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ (to sing with live accompaniment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧: live concert — typically refers to a pop or rock concert event
- ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: musical performance — does not specify whether live or recorded
